method: Forward-only: first recorded public recommendation per board/player/game/market/side/model. Original line and score never replaced. Later revisions shown but excluded as additional trials. No retrospective reconstruction.
limits: Hit rates exclude pushes, voids and unresolved outcomes. Related picks share players/games and are not independent.
Scores are rankings, not win probabilities. Compare the same sport, market, direction and model version.
ROI uses only captured real prices, one unit per priced selection; no -110 defaults or inferred payouts.
Unrecorded historical recommendations cannot be recreated honestly. Tracking starts with actual pregame captures.
First-basket house rules: first made field goal, must start. Sportsbook settlement can differ.
Public default recommendations are captured automatically; private manual lines, exclusions and bet execution are not recorded.
